run_started.text: Welcome, crawler. Your survival is not guaranteed, but it is being recorded.
Run {seed} is now live. Please keep your limbs inside the dungeon at all times.
Good news: the dungeon is open. Bad news: it is open downward.
Crawler registered. Next-of-kin field left blank. Bold choice.
This descent is brought to you by our sponsors, who would like you to keep moving.
Orientation has been skipped to save time. You will learn by doing, briefly.
Seed {seed} loaded. Management has reviewed your odds and is smiling politely.
Reminder: every room costs ticks, and every tick is somebody's quarterly target.

floor_started.text: Floor {depth} unlocked. The elevator music was cut for budget reasons.
Welcome to floor {depth}. The previous tenants left in a hurry. And in pieces.
Floor {depth}: same dungeon, worse lighting, higher stakes. Enjoy.
Descending to floor {depth}. Please note the stairs only go one way.
Floor {depth}. Our sponsors have doubled the ambient dread at no extra cost.
You are now on floor {depth}. Morale is optional. Movement is mandatory.

room_entered.start.text: Back at the start. Nostalgia is free. The ticks you spent getting here were not.
The starting room remembers you. It is not impressed.
Returning to the beginning is not the same as a fresh start.
Ah, the lobby. Do browse, but the exit is not here.
Familiar walls. Unfamiliar sense of progress.

room_entered.normal.text: Room {room}. Contents: hostile. Decor: also hostile.
Another room. Another chance to justify your oxygen.
This room has been rated 'adequate' by people who did not survive it.
Please do not feed the locals. They prefer to feed themselves.
New room discovered. The audience leans forward slightly.
You have {ticks} ticks left. The room has no opinion about that.
Floor plan updated. Your odds were not consulted.
Fresh room, same policy: survive or become scenery.

room_entered.treasure.text: A treasure room. Please resist the urge to lick the gold.
Loot detected. Terms and conditions also detected.
Shiny objects ahead. Statistically, at least one is not a trap.
This room is sponsored. Smile for the loot box.
Treasure! Management takes a modest cut of your gratitude.

room_entered.trap.text: Mind your step. Actually, mind all of your steps.
This room is a trap. We are legally required to say that now.
The floor tiles in here are load-bearing and grudge-bearing.
Hazard zone. Your insurance policy has just quietly expired.
Trap room. The architect was paid by the scream.

room_entered.shrine.text: A shrine. Offerings accepted. Refunds are not.
Shrine located. Please pray in an orderly queue of one.
The shrine hums. It may grant favour. It may grant fees.
Holy ground, conditionally. Read the small print on the altar.
A quiet shrine. The quiet costs extra.

room_entered.elite.text: Elite occupant detected. It has a performance review to ace.
Something tougher lives here. It has heard about you. It is unbothered.
Warning: above-average hostility. Above-average loot. Probably.
This one was promoted for violence. Please congratulate it carefully.
Elite room. The audience paid extra for this part.

room_entered.guild_hall.text: Guild hall. Catch your breath. It is the only free thing down here.
A safe room! Terms, conditions and the word 'safe' may vary.
The guild welcomes members, guests and anyone still breathing.
Rest stop reached. Complimentary ticks, complimentary dread.
Guild hall open. Please wipe your boots of whatever that is.

room_entered.exit.text: The stairs down. Up was never on the menu.
Exit located. Leaving is easy. Arriving is the problem.
The way down. Management thanks you for your continued descent.
Exit reached. Somewhere below, a worse floor clears its throat.
Stairwell confirmed. Please hold the railing. There is no railing.

room_entered.boss.text: The boss room, now under new management: you.
The arena is closed for cleaning. You made the mess, after all.
It is very quiet in here now. You did that.

boss_room_entered.text: Boss chamber. Please hold all applause until someone stops moving.
Main event! The odds board just updated, and not in your favour.
You have entered the boss room. The door has opinions about leaving.
Tonight's headliner is large, armoured and contractually angry.
Boss detected. Our sponsors remind you that heroism is not covered.
This is the part the trailer was cut from. Try to look good.

first_blood.text: First kill of the run. The {enemy} will be filing a complaint, posthumously.
And we have first blood! The {enemy} has been removed from the leaderboard.
First blood. The paperwork for that {enemy} is already being shredded.
Kill number one. Only several hundred to go, roughly.
The {enemy} is down. Our first casualty is, thankfully, not you.
First takedown logged. Please pace yourself; the dungeon has plenty more.

kill_streak.3.text: Three in a row without a scratch. The analysts are recalculating.
Triple! Your efficiency has been noted and will be held against you.
Streak of {streak}. A modest start. We grade on a curve.
{streak} kills, zero injuries. Suspicious. Carry on.

kill_streak.5.text: Five clean kills. Somebody upstairs just lost a bet.
Streak of {streak}! The local wildlife is forming a union.
{streak} without a hit. The audience asks you to slow down for the replay.
Five-chain. Management is drafting a polite counterstrategy.

kill_streak.8.text: {streak} kills untouched. The dungeon is filing a performance concern.
Eight straight. We have had to open a second column on the scoreboard.
Streak of {streak}. Please stop before the monsters demand hazard pay.

kill_streak.12.text: Twelve! The ratings department is on fire. Not literally. Yet.
{streak} clean kills. This was not in the forecast.
A {streak}-kill streak. Our insurers have asked us to stop showing this.

enemy_killed.rat_scavenger.text: One fewer scavenger. Several more are reviewing your file.
The rat has left the dungeon. Feet first. All four of them.

enemy_killed.spitting_rat.text: Spitting rat silenced. Please wipe your face.
That rat had range and attitude. Now it has neither.
No more spit from that one. The cleaning crew thanks you.

enemy_killed.hulking_rat.text: The hulking rat is down. Its gym membership lapses today.
Large rat, larger thud. Nicely done.
That was a lot of rat. Now it is a lot of floor.

level_up.text: Level {level}! You are now slightly harder to kill. Congratulations, conditionally.
Level {level} reached. Your stats have improved. Your situation has not.
Promoted to level {level}. No raise, but the monsters will take you seriously.
Level {level}. Please allocate your points before something allocates you.
Ding. Level {level}. The dungeon has adjusted its expectations upward.
Level {level}. Our sponsors are thrilled to keep you on the payroll.

low_hp.text: Health critical. Now would be a great time for a plan.
You are at {hp} HP. Statistically, that is a cliffhanger.
Vital signs: optional, apparently. Please reconsider.
Low health. The audience is on the edge of their seats. You are on the edge.
{hp} of {max_hp} HP left. We have pre-written a few obituaries. Just in case.
Warning: you appear to be leaking. Kindly stop.

player_damaged_big.text: Ouch. That {enemy} hit for {damage}. The replay is already trending.
{damage} damage in one go. You will want to avoid doing that again.
That one landed. The {enemy} is very proud of itself.
Big hit! Please remember: blocking with your face is not a strategy.
Heavy damage taken. Your medical plan covers none of it.

boss_defeated.text: Boss down! The {enemy} has been reassigned to the floor. Permanently.
The {enemy} is defeated. The exit unlocks with a resentful click.
Headliner eliminated. Please exit via the stairwell, and the gift shop if found.
Boss defeated! Our sponsors now claim they believed in you all along.
The {enemy} falls. Management is surprised and slightly inconvenienced.
That was the boss. You are now the scariest thing in this room. Congrats?

floor_cleared.text: Floor {depth} cleared with {ticks} ticks to spare. Your reward: a lower floor.
Floor {depth} complete. The next one is already disappointed in you.
You survived floor {depth}. The stairs are waiting, smugly.
Floor {depth} done. Please rate your experience from one to doom.
Floor cleared. {kills} kills so far. The dungeon is keeping a tally too.

ticks_low.text: Only {ticks} ticks left. The ceiling is getting ideas.
{ticks} ticks remaining. Dawdling is now a lifestyle choice with consequences.
The floor is running low on patience. {ticks} ticks, to be precise.
Clock check: {ticks} ticks. Somewhere, a support beam sighs.
Warning: {ticks} ticks left. Structural integrity is entering its villain era.
Time is short. So is the list of rooms you can still afford.

grace_started.text: Collapse imminent! A brief grace period has been granted. Very brief.
The floor is coming down. You have a moment. Spend it running.
Grace period active. Management calls this mercy. Accounting calls it a delay.
Structural failure in progress. Please evacuate in an orderly sprint.
This is your final courtesy notice from the ceiling.

grace_stabilised.text: You outran the collapse. The ceiling will remember this.
Grace period survived. The dungeon is grudgingly impressed.
Stabilised. For now. The word 'now' is doing a lot of work.
The collapse missed you. The audience exhales in unison.
Out of the danger zone. Please continue into a different danger zone.

run_ended.defeated.text: Crawler down on floor {depth}. The {enemy} accepts the trophy with grace.
And that is the run. Cause of death: {enemy}. Contributing factor: optimism.
You have died. Your {kills} kills are being donated to the dungeon archive.
Run over at level {level}. The {enemy} would like to thank its agent.
Defeated. On the bright side, you no longer owe the dungeon any ticks.
Vital signs discontinued. Please enjoy this complimentary moment of silence.

run_ended.collapsed.text: The floor collapsed. It was nothing personal. It was structural.
Out of ticks, out of floor, out of luck. Thank you for crawling.
Collapse complete. Floor {depth} has been archived, with you in it.
The ceiling has met the floor. You were the awkward bit in between.
Time is up. The dungeon reclaims its square footage.
Structural collapse on floor {depth}. Management cites 'crawler dawdling'.

run_ended.victory.text: Floor {depth} escaped! You are now, technically, a success story.
Victory. The dungeon will be updating its security in response to you.
You made it out with {ticks} ticks left. The audience demands a sequel.
Escape confirmed. Our sponsors would like a word about endorsement deals.
Clear! {kills} kills, level {level}, and only mildly traumatised.
Run complete. Please collect your complimentary dignity at the door.

run_ended.abandoned.text: Run abandoned. The dungeon pretends not to be hurt.
Leaving so soon? Your spot has already been sublet.
Abandoned on floor {depth}. The rooms will gossip about this.

idle.text: Still there? The monsters are starting to worry about you.
Standing still is a valid strategy. It is not a good one.
The dungeon does not do intermissions. Kindly crawl.
{idle} seconds of stillness. The audience is riveted, apparently.
Gentle reminder: ticks do not spend themselves. Neither do you, it seems.
If you are thinking, please think faster.
Pausing for dramatic effect? The effect has landed. Please move.
This silence has been noted in your permanent record.

chest_opened.text: Chest opened! Your loot box has been delivered, minus handling fees.
Unboxing complete. Please enjoy your contents responsibly.
A loot box! Statistically, one of these will be great someday.
Chest cracked. The sponsors hope you love it, or at least use it.
Loot acquired. The chest is now just a box with regrets.

shrine_used.text: Shrine used. Your offering has been processed. Blessing pending.
The shrine accepts your devotion and your ticks, in that order.
Blessing applied. Side effects may include confidence.
Prayer received. Please allow three to five floors for results.
The shrine glows. That is either good news or very bright bad news.

guild_rested.text: Rested at the guild. Your wounds are fewer and your bill is larger.
A short rest. The dungeon waited. Impatiently.
Refreshed! The guild thanks you for your patronage and your blood.
Rest complete. Please return your pillow to the nearest skeleton.
Guild rest logged. Do try not to need another one immediately.

hazard_spawned.text: New hazard deployed. We call it 'interactive scenery'.
Something nasty just appeared. It was not in the brochure.
Hazard online. Please treat it as a suggestion to leave.
